name: mx_jinja_chain_ip_extract
why: The matrix drives a bare model loop (no delivery/verdict guards),
so its build scores measure the model, not the assistant. This row
sends the same prompt through chat_turn and grades the delivered
playbook with the SAME ir_assertions (`behaves`), plus that the turn
actually delivered it. The prompt must stay equal to the task's

steps.user: Author a FortiSOAR playbook that, on alert creation, picks the first IP out of `vars.input.records[0].sourceIps` (a list of strings) and submits it to the virustotal connector's query_ip operation. The IP param expects an IPv4 string. Use exactly one set_variable step before the virustotal step to bind the extracted IP into a variable named `target_ip`. Output complete YAML.
